dataset_metadata.study_title: Digital support systems to improve child development in Peru: A cluster-randomized controlled open label trial

participant_reconciliation.reconciliation_resolution: The observed sample with valid standardized primary outcome gsed_Z is exactly 2,149, matching the published Table 2 primary analysis sample. The actual exclusions from 2,461 to 2,149 are 312 participants (307 raw outcome non-responses + 5 singleton age-group drops). The published figure of 332 exclusions leaves an unexplained 20-participant discrepancy (332 vs 312) that cannot be resolved from the released data or code.

weeks_active_and_program_time.consistency_note: Consistent with published documentation noting four control households erroneously accessing the intervention and with the Stata replication script compliance definition coding control participants with non-missing weeks_active as non-compliant.

csv_dta_equivalence_audit.notes: CSV and DTA are 100% content-equivalent across all 2,461 participant records and 40 variables. Differences are strictly representational (native Stata encodings and value labels vs. text exports).
